The pattern is stronger than ordinary day-to-day noise because it appears repeatedly over multiple days. hypotheses.label: An intermittent environmental or handling effect is perturbing the pendulum measurements, without changing the underlying instrument permanently
hypotheses.rationale: The day 7–10 values are not a clean monotonic drift; they fluctuate around a higher level, which is compatible with variable environmental influence, setup disturbance, or measurement procedure differences. It is less strong than a true instrument shift because the displacement persists across several days, but it remains plausible given the incomplete information and the lack of post-baseline resonator drift.
